prompt:
The snippet snippets/predictive-search-script-2.liquid loads the predictive search JavaScript and stylesheet and renders the predictive-search custom element. Several literal references in it use the wrong letter case, so they do not resolve: Shopify matches asset filenames (including the extension), translation keys and snippet names exactly and case-sensitively. Theme Check currently reports missing asset, missing translation key and missing snippet errors for this file.

The real theme files are supplied as extra files:
- assets/predictive-search.js
- assets/predictive-search.css
- snippets/loading-spinner.liquid
- locales/en.default.json and locales/fr.json, both containing the nested object templates.search with the keys loading, results_label, no_results and view_all (all lowercase).

Fix the snippet so that every reference resolves exactly:
1. The script element's src must use asset_url on assets/predictive-search.js.
2. The stylesheet loaded through asset_url | stylesheet_tag must be assets/predictive-search.css (lowercase extension).
3. The data-loading-text attribute of the predictive-search element must use the translation key templates.search.loading.
4. The aria-label of the results listbox must use templates.search.results_label.
5. Inside the results listbox the snippet loading-spinner must be rendered.
6. The status span must use templates.search.no_results, keeping its existing terms: search_terms argument.
7. The view-all link text must use templates.search.view_all.

Do not rename, create or edit any asset, locale or snippet file. Do not change the markup, attributes (including defer), classes, filter arguments or ordering; change only the literal operands that are wrong. References that already resolve must stay unchanged. When finished, Theme Check must report no missing asset, missing translation key or missing snippet errors for this file. Change only snippets/predictive-search-script-2.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
